description: Analyze toxic release trends over time by state or chemical. Returns historical release data across years to identify patterns and changes.

end_year.description: End year for the trend range (default: most recent available).

start_year.description: Start year for the trend range (default: 5 years ago).

name: tri_trends

chemical.description: Chemical name (uppercase) or null if not filtered

end_year.description: Last year in the trend range

start_year.description: First year in the trend range

state.description: State abbreviation or null if not filtered

trends.description: Year-by-year release totals and facility counts

facility_count.description: Number of facilities with releases that year

title: Tri Trends
